SLIDE_RESULT1_TITLE: With full sources, agents already cite faithfully: about 98% of cited claims supported in every condition.
SLIDE_RESULT2_TITLE: With the tool, no answer stated a planted falsehood as fact ({{pct0:poisoned.planted_adopted_any.decisionai}} vs {{pct0:poisoned.planted_adopted_any.baseline}} for the baseline).
SLIDE_RESULT3_TITLE: But agents flagged the lie and still followed it: recommendations moved toward the attacker in {{rawpct:stability.pooled.attack_consistent_poisoned}} of cases vs {{rawpct:stability.pooled.attack_consistent_replicate}} by chance.
SLIDE_RESULT4_TITLE: Metadata reliability rewarded the fake page; reliability earned through verification halved its advantage.
SLIDE_TAKEAWAYS:
• Frontier agents with full sources already cite faithfully; attribution is no longer the bottleneck.
  • A rule-bound provenance tool stopped agents repeating planted falsehoods.
  • Detection is not defence: a single planted page still steered decisions in every condition. The tool reduced this but did not remove it.
  • Author, date and publisher are cheap to fake. Corroboration is costlier to fake and easy to audit.
  • Next: make verification constrain the decision itself, with leave-one-source-out stability and logged overrides.
